name: room-climate-card
description: Build and test tooling for the Room Climate Card Home Assistant custom card. Sources live in src/ (ES modules); the card ships as a single, dependency-free bundle at dist/room-climate-card.js for HACS/Lovelace and does not require any of this tooling to run in Home Assistant.

scripts.test: npm run verify:dist && npm run check:run && npm run test:unit:run && npm run test:browser:run
scripts.check: npm run verify:dist && npm run check:run
scripts.test:unit: npm run verify:dist && npm run test:unit:run
scripts.test:unit:verbose: npm run verify:dist && npm run test:unit:verbose:run
scripts.test:browser: npm run verify:dist && npm run test:browser:run
scripts.test:fuzz: npm run verify:dist && npm run test:fuzz:run
